title: qeegq's chili's!
description: This mod adds just a chili what did you expect
body:
Hello there! this is my frist ever mod so please do NOT judge me for adding just an chili xD

just eat a chili
it can stack up only up to 16 just so ya know! (the spicy chili can stack up only up to 8 and the big chili can only stack up to 2)
